added.summary: `og check` warns (OG9108) where a game's TSX writes a ground or an ink by hand: a thinned ink (`text-fg/66`: use `text-fg-muted` or `text-fg-subtle`), a literal `white` or `black` ground or ink, a hand-written colour (`bg-[#…]`), or a ground under text less than 85% opaque (`bg-well/82`, `from-entry-lo`). Each warning names the slot or theme role that fixes it. Text sits on a pack slot or an opaque theme ground in that ground's ink, so it reads over any scene and in every pack.

added.member: Style pack slots Row.frame and Head.frame
added.summary: Two new pack slots for the lists, tables and feeds a HUD lays over the scene: `packClass("Row", "frame")` (an opaque `bg-raised-lo text-fg` row; `selected` for the chosen or local player's row, `muted` for one out of play) and `packClass("Head", "frame")` (a table or list's head row). A game's pack restyles them like any slot.
